[TASK: 2560x1440 2K QHD 16:9 ARCHITECTURAL RELIGHTING & STATIC RECONSTRUCTION]
Transform the reference photogrammetry plate into a razor-sharp, photorealistic 6x7 medium-format architectural survey photograph.

MANDATORY TRANSFORMATION RULES:
1. PLANAR RECTIFICATION & GEOMETRY LOCK: Treat the reference image as an immutable spatial coordinate frame. Eliminate all 3D mesh polygon wobble, melted facades, and distorted rooflines. Plumb all vertical walls to true gravity vertical. Render razor-sharp ashlar courses, straight timber sash mullions, and crisp slate roofs.
2. STATIC DECLUTTERING (MANDATORY): COMPLETELY ERASE all transient vehicles, parked cars, delivery vans, pedestrians, and temporary street clutter from the seed image. Repaint the carriageway with authentic road surfacing, stone setts, whinstone kerbs, and clean flagstone pavements.
3. BOTANICAL PHENOLOGY & CANOPY INTEGRITY: Overwrite all raw 3D mesh blob foliage with authentic seasonal canopy structures matching the target date. Zero green summer foliage during dormant/autumn/winter periods:
   Street-level canopy anchors consist of mature urban broadleaf trees:
- *Gleditsia triacanthos* var. *inermis* (Thornless Honeylocust): Compound pinnate foliage forming an open, spreading crown along sidewalk easements.
- *Ulmus americana* (American Elm / Princeton cultivar): Vase-shaped branching habit with dense, fully expanded dark green foliage.
- *Acer rubrum* (Red Maple): Full, dense late-summer crowns showing peak canopy density with mature, deep green leaf morphology and zero defoliation.
4. OPTICAL DEPTH: Pin-sharp infinite depth of field (f/11). Zero lens blur, tilt-shift, or depth-of-field falloff across foreground and background.

[SOLAR & ATMOSPHERIC LIGHTING OVERRIDE]
ATMOSPHERIC LIGHTING (OVERCAST): 100% overcast cloud cover. Soft omnidirectional 6500K diffuse skylight. Zero harsh directional cast shadows; render ambient contact occlusion under cornices and ledges only.

[SCENE GEOMETRY & AUTHENTIC LITHICS]
Medium format architectural documentary survey, 6x7 format, high-density structural precision. Spatial view of College Hill descending toward downtown Providence, centered on 16 Angell Street and the 1885 Carr Mansion. In the foreground, an asymmetrical three-and-a-half-storey Queen Anne brick-and-timber mansion features a cylindrical corner turret with a slate conical roof, complex flared cross-gables in Vermont black slate, corbelled red brick chimney stacks, half-timbered upper gables, and a Westerly granite base. Adjoining midground comprises the Rhode Island School of Design brick studio complex, featuring multistory pressed red brick masonry in English bond, verdigris oxidized copper clerestory monitor roofs, industrial saw-tooth glass skylights, a tall cylindrical brick smokestack, and factory steel sash windows. The background reveals the downtown skyline of limestone ashlar towers and precast concrete facades. Sidewalks retain clean saw-cut granite kerbs, herringbone brick pavers, and mature Acer rubrum and Gleditsia triacanthos trees with fully developed, dense late-summer deep-green canopies. Verticals are strictly plumbed, planar surfaces rectified, structural load paths aligned. Completely devoid of vehicles, pedestrians, dumpsters, or street clutter. Clean, static municipal civil architectural documentation.
